reviewDescription: I’ve been using these headphones for almost two months. The sound quality was never amazing, but it was decent enough for work calls at first. Over time, though, they’ve become unreliable. The audio now randomly disconnects during calls. I use Zoom every day, and I can see from the AI notes that the other person is still talking, but I can’t hear anything. At the same time, they can hear me just fine. That kind of issue makes them frustrating and impractical for daily use. I wouldn’t recommend them.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on April 16, 2026
